questions.question: After King Saul died in battle, an Amalekite brought David two things that belonged to Saul. What were they?
When David heard that King Saul and Jonathan were dead, he tore his clothes, and all the men with him did the same. True or false?
David summoned a young man and gave an order about the Amalekite who said he had killed King Saul. What was the order?
In David's song for Saul and Jonathan, why did he not want the news told in Gath and Ashkelon?

answers.text: So the Philistines would not rejoice
So no one would attack Judah
So Israel could hear it first
